mdrk.review:
I'll put my grades aside since my final wasn't the best and that's pretty much on me, MdRK in my opinion is genuinely one of the best math faculties I got in NSU. An amazing human, he is very eager to teach and will always make sure to explain by examples. His notes are very thorough and his quizzes are mcq based so he will be giving questions from there.
Sir is very interactive in class and if you can grab his attention that will come to your advantage.
Point to be noted: He is eager to give you opportunities to earn your marks. My section didn't do too well on midterm so he agreed to take a makeup mid so we could get better scores. He even took an extra quiz just so we could do better but he did consider the marks for the number of quizzes he initially intended to. Grading is pretty fair, I would say he curves a decent amount. So just be regular in class and communicate with him. You are good to go.
